acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.text: By accessing and using the Catequese Viva platform, you agree to these Terms of Use.

service.title: 2. Service Description
service.text: Catequese Viva is a SaaS platform for Catholic catechesis management: classes, attendance, content, sacraments, and pastoral communication.

obligations.title: 3. User Obligations
items: Do not share your account with third parties
Use the platform only for catechesis and pastoral purposes
Respect LGPD rules when handling catechumen data

liability.title: 4. Limitation of Liability
liability.text: Catequese Viva is not responsible for content published by users, pastoral decisions based on platform data, or temporary unavailability.

jurisdiction.title: 5. Jurisdiction
jurisdiction.text: The courts of São Paulo, Brazil, are elected to resolve any disputes arising from these Terms of Use.

intro.title: 1. Introduction
intro.text: Catequese Viva is committed to protecting users' personal data, in compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13.709/2018). This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.

collected.title: 2. Data collected
collected.intro: We collect only data strictly necessary to provide services:
items: Name, email, and phone of users (catechists, coordinators, guardians)
Name and date of birth of catechumens

purpose.title: 3. Purpose of processing
items: Pastoral communication between coordinators, catechists, and families
Comply with legal and canonical obligations

minors.title: 4. Protection of minors' data
minors.text: Children's and adolescents' data receives special protection: minimal collection, mandatory parental consent, restricted access, and no sharing with third parties.

rights.title: 5. Your rights (LGPD)
rights.text: Access, correct, export, or request deletion of your data. To exercise these rights, go to Settings in the app or contact contato@catequeseviva.com.br.
